snippet.description:
Revision is not something you should leave for the end of your UPSC preparation.

The LevelUp Mentorship Program (LMP) builds revision into your preparation through systematic tests and assignments. As you move ahead, your tests continue to include topics studied in previous months, ensuring that what you studied in September, October and November is not forgotten by December.

This helps you:

Revise topics consistently
Retain what you have already studied
Identify gaps through regular tests
Stay on track with your UPSC preparation
Avoid the “I studied it, but I don’t remember it anymore” problem

With LMP, revision becomes part of the system—not something you have to figure out later.
